name: Sirius Oswald
original_name: シリウス オズワルド
source:
Thoughtful & Sexy

While looking out for others and being adored by hismen as a reliable ranked leader, the Queen of Spades guides the young king without sparing his blunt personality. He's a stickler for tidiness and enjoys the quiet of gardening. He seems to have history with Lancelot, the opposing king.

"Come now, be a big girl and don't you cry. I can't stand seeing tears fall from your eyes." 

[Official in-game description]
